blindedRules.named: These rules identify a React value by asking the checker for its type, so they cannot analyse this file and will report nothing in it: {{rules}}. Suppressing this finding turns those off for the file rather than tidying a type.
blindedRules.unlinked: Every rule that identifies a React value by its type is disabled for this file, and this build linked none of them so none can be named.

reactHookNoAnyType.text: `{{hookName}}` here resolves to `any`, so the type checker cannot see what this hook returns. <<blindedRules>>React's types are probably not resolving here: check that `@types/react` is installed and current, that no ambient declaration is shadowing it, and that the path mapping for `react` resolves.
